can you pay provision of the silsila if you burned the contracted
minion? by the time you burn them they're in an ash heap and the

salem.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes, because you "fit the exact requirements" stated on card text -
you have just finished a combat in which the opposing minion had
a contract for which you were named and the opposing minion is no
longer ready.
